detail.business: – Information about our Executive Officers, will be included in our Proxy Statement for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the "2026 Proxy Statement"). The 2026 Proxy Statement will be filed within 120 days after the close of the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 and such information is incorporated herein by reference. The Company has an insider trading policy which governs the purchase, sale, and/or other dispositions of our securities (and related derivative securities) by directors, officers and employees and other covered persons and is designed to promote compliance with insider trading laws, rules and regulations, and listing standards applicable to the Company. A copy of our Securities Trading Policy is included as Exhibit 19.1 to this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Item 11. Executive Compensation .
